firstIncorrectBoundary.expected: Resolve the exact Daily Current identity, acquire the accepted Current owner, and invoke Rolling Daily production operations only from the owner callback.
firstIncorrectBoundary.actual: Every Daily request emits current_compute_start and invokes rollingDailyOperations.run directly without CURRENT_LOGICAL_ARTIFACT_KEY_V1 construction or CurrentForecastSingleFlight.run.

rootCause.whyP03Passed: P03 contains only the Monthly Generic Period Current key. That route executes prepared lookup, exact key construction, and CurrentForecastSingleFlight.run, yielding one owner callback and one compute.
rootCause.whyP04Failed: P04 adds a Rolling Daily key. Its four requests are dispatched directly to Rolling Daily production operations before the accepted Current ownership boundary. Monthly and Quarterly still collapse to one compute each, so 4 + 1 + 1 = 6.
